mode: read-only inventory; no deletion in this audit
measurement: du -k allocated blocks; APFS clone/shared extents can affect physical space actually reclaimed

manifestEvidence.method: Existing payload manifests grouped by sorted original resource path/SHA256. This compares recorded checksums, not a fresh hash of every duplicate file.

recommendation.first: Archive and verify differing independent source/manifests; retain one current candidate and one rollback per desktop platform; remove superseded generated bundles and unpacked copies. Keep original artifacts and analysis evidence.
recommendation.estimatedReclaimGiB: 30-32, directory-accounting estimate; measure actual df delta after cleanup
recommendation.future: Use source host/shared original assets for iteration; package only reviewable milestones; automatically cap retained full bundles to current+rollback per platform. Keep small source diffs/manifests/reports for all stages.
recommendation.second: Review large logs and versioned decoded trees separately; do not treat different versions/platforms as interchangeable or delete original packages or Git history.
